subject: Update README and address all clippy warnings
reason: The change is a README update, an optional clippy build-dependency in Cargo.toml, and mechanical clippy-lint refactors: &Vec<RedisString> parameters become &[RedisString], explicit index loops become equivalent iterator chains (take(len).skip(start) covers the same range in the same order), &RedisString deref coercion to &[u8] is replaced by the equivalent as_slice(), repeated Vec pushes become a vec! literal with the same elements in the same order, and an import is replaced by fully-qualified paths. Every command's arity checks, argument parsing, stored filter state, and replies are byte-for
